content.value_statement: HR teams need structured, fair, and compliant materials for employee workflows. This skill creates templates, checklists, and prompts that keep legal context and privacy in view.
actual_capabilities: Creates job descriptions, structured interview kits, rubrics, scorecards, and candidate communications.
Drafts onboarding and offboarding checklists, first-week schedules, and 30/60/90 plans.
Builds PTO and leave policy drafts with accrual, eligibility, carryover, and coverage planning prompts.
Prepares competency matrices, goal-setting frameworks, review packets, and performance improvement plan templates.
Provides employee relations intake templates, investigation plans, findings memo outlines, and documentation standards.
Adds jurisdiction prompts, legal disclaimers, privacy notes, and counsel escalation points.
limitations: Provides general HR information and templates, not legal advice.
Requires jurisdiction, company context, and policy constraints for specific guidance.
Does not verify current local laws or replace qualified employment counsel.
Should not collect or store sensitive employee data unless strictly necessary.

use_cases.title: Build Hiring Materials
use_cases.description: Create a job description, interview questions, scoring rubric, panel plan, and candidate messages for a role.

use_cases.title: Standardize Employee Workflows
use_cases.description: Produce onboarding, offboarding, leave, and policy checklists that include owners, timelines, and privacy notes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Performance Documentation
use_cases.description: Draft review packets, competency matrices, coaching plans, and factual documentation standards for employee relations issues.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a PTO Policy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single HR policy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an accrual-based PTO policy for {{CompanyName}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. Include eligibility, request workflow, carryover, blackout periods, and legal review notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Interview Kit
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate hiring workflow with structured evaluation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured interview kit for {{RoleTitle}} in {{Department}}. Include competencies, 10 questions, scoring anchors, panel plan, and candidate communications.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Onboarding Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 30/60/90 onboarding plan for a remote {{RoleTitle}}. Include learning goals, stakeholder map, first-week schedule, checklists, and feedback points.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Employee Relations Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request involving documentation and risk controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an employee relations package for {{IssueType}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. Include intake questions, investigation plan, notes format, findings memo outline, and counsel escalation points.

output_examples.input: Draft a structured interview kit for a customer success manager in California.
output_examples.output: A Markdown package with role outcomes, competencies, interview questions, scoring anchors, panel assignments, debrief steps, and lawful topic reminders.

output_examples.input: Create a 30/60/90 plan for a remote product designer joining a 120-person company.
output_examples.output: A staged onboarding plan with learning goals, stakeholder meetings, deliverables, first-week checklist, feedback checkpoints, and communication draft.

output_examples.input: Prepare a performance improvement plan template for missed sales activity targets.
output_examples.output: A coaching-focused template with objective expectations, evidence standards, check-in cadence, support resources, success measures, and legal review notes.

best_practices: Provide jurisdiction, company size, employment type, and policy constraints before requesting final materials.
Use objective, job-related criteria for hiring, reviews, investigations, and performance documentation.
Ask local counsel to review high-risk actions before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request discriminatory hiring criteria, illegal interview questions, or protected-class assumptions.
Do not treat generated HR templates as final legal advice.
Do not include unnecessary medical, leave, immigration, or other sensitive personal data.

faq.question: Can this skill give legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general HR information and templates. Qualified local counsel should review high-risk or jurisdiction-specific decisions.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide jurisdiction, company size, employment type, union status, work model, and relevant internal policy constraints.

faq.question: Can it create interview scorecards?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create structured questions, competency rubrics, scoring anchors, panel plans, and debrief checklists.

faq.question: Does it support onboarding and offboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft checklists, communication drafts, access steps, 30/60/90 plans, and feedback loops.

faq.question: How does it handle privacy?
faq.answer: It asks for minimum necessary information and includes reminders to avoid unnecessary sensitive personal data.

faq.question: Can it help with performance issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft review packets, coaching plans, performance improvement plan templates, and factual documentation standards.
